# Roam

Roam HQ provides APIs for secure messaging, chat, file sharing, and collaboration with enterprise-grade security and compliance features.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/roam/.

## Actions

- **Get Address Info** (read-only): Get information about a chat address, which is the name for any entity that may participate in a chat, such as a user, visitor, or bot.
- **Get meeting link** (read-only): Get a meeting link.
- **Get SCIM schema** (read-only): Retrieves the definition of a specific SCIM 2.0 schema by its unique identifier (URN).
- **Post message to chat**: Post a message to a chat.
- **Send message to group**: Sends the given message to the specified recipients.
- **Upload File to Roam**: Upload a file to Roam so it can be sent as a chat attachment.
- **Add group members**: Add one or more group members and/or admins to an existing Roam group.
- **Add Reaction to Message**: Add an emoji reaction to a message in a chat.
- **Create Group**: Create a group address that can be used for chat.
- **Create Roam SCIM Group**: Create a new group in your Roam organization using SCIM 2.0.
- **Create Roam User**: Create a new user in Roam via SCIM 2.0 protocol for automated user provisioning.
- **Delete Roam Group**: Archive a group in Roam using SCIM 2.0 protocol.
- **Delete Roam User**: Archive a user in Roam using SCIM 2.0 protocol.
- **Get chat history** (read-only): Lists messages in a chat, filtered by date range (after/before).
- **Get Roam SCIM Resource Types** (read-only): Returns the list of SCIM 2.0 resource types supported by Roam.
- **Get SCIM service provider config** (read-only): Retrieve Roam's SCIM service provider configuration.
- **Get token info** (read-only): Retrieves information about the current Roam access token.
- **Get user by ID (SCIM)** (read-only): Retrieve a single user by their Roam Person ID using SCIM 2.0 protocol.
- **Get user info** (read-only): Get detailed information about a single user in your Roam workspace.
- **List group members** (read-only): List members in a group in your Roam workspace.
- **List Roam Chats** (read-only): Lists all accessible chats, which consist of all DMs, MultiDMs, and Channels that your bot has been added to, in addition to all public…
- **List Roam Lobbies** (read-only): Lists active lobbies in your Roam account.
- **List Roam Meetings** (read-only): Lists all meetings in your home Roam, filtered by date range.
- **List Roam Recordings** (read-only): List all recordings in your home Roam.
- **List Roam Transcripts** (read-only): Lists all transcripts in your Roam workspace, filtered by date range.
- **List SCIM Groups** (read-only): Returns a paginated list of groups in your Roam organization via SCIM 2.0.
- **List SCIM Schemas** (read-only): List all SCIM 2.0 schemas supported by Roam.
- **List User Audit Log** (read-only): Get a list of user audit log entries for the account.
- **List Users** (read-only): List all users in the Roam workspace.
- **List users (SCIM)** (read-only): List users in your Roam organization using SCIM 2.0 protocol.
- **Lookup user by email** (read-only): Look up a user in your Roam workspace by their email address.
- **Patch a group**: Partially updates a group using SCIM 2.0 protocol.
- **Patch user (SCIM)**: Partially updates a user using SCIM 2.0 protocol.
- **Remove group members**: Remove one or more members from a group in your Roam workspace.
- **Replace Roam SCIM Group**: Fully replaces a group's attributes using SCIM 2.0 protocol.
- **Replace Roam User**: Fully replaces (updates) a user's attributes in Roam via SCIM 2.0 protocol.
- **Send Typing Indicator**: Notify other chat participants that you are typing.
- **Test API Connectivity** (read-only): Test endpoint for API connectivity.
- **Update a meeting link**: Update settings for an existing meeting link in Roam.
